model.summary: Model favors NO by 0.2 points (52% win chance). Biggest factors: Rest days (home minus away) (NO +1.6), Offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (CLE +1.3), Home team off a bye (CLE +1.1). The baseline of +1.9 covers typical home-field advantage.

total_model.summary: Model projects 45.7 total points (NO 23, CLE 23). Biggest factors: Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (lowers total 2.5), Combined offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (raises total 1.8), Expected points from both teams' scoring (season blend) (lowers total 1.1). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
